# Authentic v4 active-hunt migration fixture

`v4-active-hunt-save.json` was generated by the actual published v4 rules at
commit `9c84ff43ef3f9e1ea444fa90d7dee46a5e1c2b0d`, copied from Git into an isolated
temporary Godot project. It was not reconstructed using the v5 validator.
The source file hashes, generator hash, and fixture hash are in `manifest.json`.

The real command route creates seed 711, allocates one point each to Might,
Vitality, and Spirit, starts the first Briar Kennels contract on registry 1,
and casts Ward. The save is captured at tick 6, with Ward committed and the
hero still in recovery. The original crypt geometry, spawn positions, pending
encounter, registered loot, resource cost, and live action state are preserved.

The `realm` and `action` fields are serialized JSON strings, matching the
existing progression fixture format. `continuationTicks` is 60, and
`expectedContinuation` is the serialized action produced by advancing those
60 ticks through the frozen v4 engine. Both the original and reloaded v4
action were advanced and compared before this fixture was written.

`generate_v4_fixture.gd` records the exact generator. To reproduce it, run it
inside a temporary checkout of the source commit with the seven source/data
files listed in the manifest and a minimal Godot project. The generator
requires `Realm.VERSION == 4`; it intentionally refuses current game rules.
Use isolated XDG data, configuration, and cache directories for this process.

The fixture contains only deterministic game state, with no player data or
credentials. It must remain unchanged when the current schema is upgraded.

## Original saved route that grazes a corner

`v4-grazing-path-save.json` captures a real move accepted and restored by the
same published ActionRules source. It uses the authentic pending registry
above and requests movement from `[0, 8]` to
`[-5.00040006637573, 0.319999992847443]`. The old sampled clearance misses a
small intersection with a pillar corner; exact clearance detects it.

This fixture protects compatibility with those existing saves. Loading must
preserve the snapshot exactly. The first resumed movement step safely
replans the obsolete route to the original destination. New commands and
current registered layouts must continue to use exact clearance, while
malformed routes, rewards, and actions remain invalid.

`generate_v4_grazing_fixture.gd` reproduces the captured snapshot inside the
same temporary frozen-source project. Copy `v4-active-hunt-save.json` into
its indicated fixture path first. The generator checks the old ActionRules
source hash before accepting any result. The manifest records the untouched
fixture hash, source hash, generator hash, and exact command.
